curriculum: University College Utrecht, part of Utrecht University, offers an interdisciplinary English-taught Liberal Arts and Sciences degree. The generic normalized programme leaves the degree award and discipline unspecified. An interdomain Humanities and Social Sciences BA is a formally available representative example based on the programme’s examples of linking disciplines in the study of culture and society. It is one of several structures and is selected independently of UCR fit. The credit map uses the 75 EC major minimum including a 15 EC thesis, the semester-one 7.5 EC Academic Core, one 7.5 EC qualifying Language and Culture course, 30 EC of nonoverlapping methodology and 60 EC of further choice. Article 3.6 requires each domain’s methods before the thesis even if it is written in one domain, and permits fewer courses when choices overlap. Introductory Humanities and Social Sciences methods are UCACCMET13 and UCACCMET12 respectively; each domain has a minimum 7.5 EC at level 2. Language and methodology required for the degree or major are excluded from the 75 EC minimum.
progression: Students complete 30 EC each semester, with Research in Context in semester one and one eligible course from each of the three domains during the first year. Science breadth is within the further choices and the humanities and social-science breadth can come from major courses. Language and Culture is due by semester four and cannot meet breadth. By midterm of semester three students declare the major. The major contains at least two disciplinary tracks from first-level work through UCU advanced finishers, plus the final-year thesis. The degree requires at least 45 EC at level 3, including at least 30 EC within the major. At the minimum major allocation the two 7.5 EC advanced finishers and the 15 EC thesis count toward the degree total and a further 15 EC of level 3 work is needed. Students finish the applicable level 2 methods before thesis. The official guides identify distinct options including formal logic for relevant Humanities disciplines and qualitative inquiry or multivariate statistics for eligible Social Sciences disciplines. The credit map leaves the track, method and approved elective choices open.

Humanities and Social Sciences major coursework
Complete tracks in at least two disciplines. The two advanced track finishers and the separately listed thesis account for at least 30 EC of level 3 work in the major.
Complete the relevant methodology requirements before starting this final-year thesis within the major.
Further course choices, including Science breadth
Take a Science course in the first year as part of the breadth requirement. The remaining credits allow further major study, electives or other approved choices.
